meta.title: QC Note Builder
meta.subtitle: Build semicolon-ready review notes from a flexible set of sections, then tune the config without touching the code.

sections.label: Domain Match
sections.helper: Choose the closest fit for the task's domain.

options.label: Domain Match
options.note: The evaluator's domains are a match.

options.label: Adjacent Domain
options.note: The task is included in the evaluator's additionally approved domains

options.label: Domain Mismatch
options.note: The task is not included in the evaluator's approved domains.

sections.label: Domain Knowledge
sections.helper: Rate the level of domain understanding shown in the review.

options.label: Excellent
options.note: The evaluation demonstrates excellent domain knowledge.

options.label: Appropriate
options.note: The evaluation demonstrates appropriate domain knowledge.

options.label: Passable
options.note: The evaluation demonstrates passable domain knowledge.

options.label: Insufficient
options.note: The evaluation demonstrates insufficient domain knowledge.

sections.label: Scoring
sections.helper: Note how well the score tracks with the rationale.

options.label: Scoring aligns with rationale
options.note: The scoring aligns with the rationales.

options.label: Minor rationale and scoring issue
options.note: There is a minor issue between the rationales and the scoring.

options.label: Scoring does not align with rationale
options.note: The scoring does not align with the rationales.

options.label: Scoring not grounded in guidelines
options.note: The scoring is not grounded in the guidelines.

sections.label: Evidence Quality
sections.helper: Choose the best description of evidence usage.

options.label: Strong use of concrete evidence
options.note: The rationale uses strong, concrete evidence.

options.label: Adequate evidence cited
options.note: The rationale cites adequate evidence.

options.label: Limited evidence cited
options.note: The rationale cites limited evidence.

options.label: Does not cite evidence / examples
options.note: The rationale does not cite evidence or examples.

sections.label: Rationales
sections.helper: Capture the best description of the rationale quality.

options.label: Concise Bullets
options.note: The rationale is concise and easy to scan.

options.label: Well Written
options.note: The rationale is well written and easy to understand.

options.label: Adequate
options.note: The rationale is adequate, though it could be stronger.

options.label: Too Verbose
options.note: The rationale is more verbose than necessary.

options.label: Shallow Rationales
options.note: The rationale lacks depth and specificity.

options.label: Unclear / Difficult to Follow
options.note: The rationale is difficult to follow.

options.label: Dimensional bleed
options.note: The rationale mixes dimensions in a way that blurs the scoring basis.

sections.label: Strengths
sections.helper: Pick every strength you want reflected in the note.

options.label: Specific examples / evidence used
options.note: Specific examples or evidence were used effectively.

options.label: Complete criteria coverage
options.note: The rationale covered the criteria completely.

options.label: SIF applied correctly
options.note: SIF expectations were applied correctly.

sections.label: Rewrite Scope
sections.helper: Capture the level of rewrite effort required.

options.label: No Rewrite Required
options.note: No rewrite is required.

options.label: Minor Rewrite Needed
options.note: A minor rewrite is needed.

options.label: Complete Rewrite Needed
options.note: A complete rewrite is needed.

options.label: SIF Criteria Rewrite Only
options.note: Only the SIF criteria portion needs a rewrite.

sections.label: Areas for Improvement
sections.helper: Mark every issue that should appear in the note.

options.label: Does Not Cite Evidence / Examples
options.note: The rationale does not cite evidence or examples.

options.label: Criteria Missing
options.note: Important criteria are missing from the rationale.

options.label: SIF Criteria Missing
options.note: Relevant SIF criteria are missing.

options.label: Scores and Ranking Misaligned
options.note: The scores or ranking do not align with the rationale.

sections.label: Affected Dimensions
sections.helper: Use this when the issues map to specific dimensions.

options.label: Content Quality
options.note: Content Quality is affected.

options.label: Storytelling
options.note: Storytelling is affected.

options.label: Aesthetics
options.note: Aesthetics are affected.

options.label: Layout
options.note: Layout is affected.

options.label: Editability
options.note: Editability is affected.

options.label: Overall Score
options.note: The Overall Score is affected.

options.label: Overall Ranking
options.note: The Overall Ranking is affected.

options.label: Pass
options.note: QC outcome is Pass.

options.label: Pass with Minor Issues
options.note: QC outcome is Pass with Minor Issues.

options.label: Minor Rewrite Required
options.note: QC outcome is Minor Rewrite Required.

options.label: Complete Rewrite Required
options.note: QC outcome is Complete Rewrite Required.

options.label: PAI
options.note: QC outcome is PAI.
